title: ONP Publisher Key Record
description: Machine-checkable structural schema for the Publisher Key Record hosted at https://{publisher-domain}/.well-known/onp/publisher.json, derived from ONP-0004 v0.2.0 Section 5.1 and Appendix A. Structural check only: TLS/WebPKI validation, the resolution algorithm (Section 6.1), and revocation-window semantics (Section 4.4) are runtime behavior outside JSON Schema's reach. Unknown additional members are permitted (unlike the closed News Object envelope): the record is a hosted document a publisher may extend, and ONP-0004 nowhere closes its member set.

onp_trust_anchor_type.description: ONP-0004 Section 4.2: 'domain' is the REQUIRED baseline; 'eudi' is reserved for ONP-2300 and not yet normatively defined, so this schema accepts only 'domain'.

current_keys.description: ONP-0004 Section 4.4 rule 1: keys presently authorized. valid_until/revoked_at are not required here; they belong to previous_keys entries.

previous_keys.description: ONP-0004 Section 4.4 rules 1-2: rotated keys, each REQUIRED to carry both validity-window bounds.

transparency_log.description: ONP-0004 Section 4.5: OPTIONAL, never a validation precondition (rule 3).

rotation_continuity_signature.description: ONP-0004 Section 4.4 rule 5: RECOMMENDED continuity evidence; a Node MUST NOT require it.

algorithm.description: Compared case-insensitively against the signature's algorithm-id per ONP-1003 Section 4.5 step 4.

public_key.description: Unpadded base64url-encoded raw public key bytes.

revoked_at.description: ONP-0004 Section 4.4 rule 4: signing time at or after this instant is untrusted.
